configurations.//: Attach-only (url, no command): connects to the `composer dev` server already on :8000 instead of racing it for the port. The port is NOT interchangeable, so autoPort must stay off — APP_URL is pinned to http://localhost:8000 and every asset('storage/...') URL the player loads is absolute against it, so a reassigned port would break lesson media and session cookies.
configurations.name: serve

configurations.//: Fallback for when `composer dev` is not running (e.g. a long test run took it down). Same pinned port for the same reason as above: APP_URL and every asset() URL are absolute against :8000. PHP_INI_SCAN_DIR lifts PHP's 2 MB upload ceiling to the 8 MB the image picker offers — this machine loads no php.ini, so without it the compiled defaults apply. See build/php-ini/.
configurations.name: serve-standalone
